CustomField.description: Reports "Email / Activity" when the most recent touch came from a synced Task/Event rather than a logged Interaction. Otherwise mirrors Last Interaction Type.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(LastActivityDate)), OR( ISBLANK(Last_Interaction_Date__c), LastActivityDate > Last_Interaction_Date__c ) ), "Email / Activity", TEXT(Last_Interaction_Type__c) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How the most recent contact happened. "Email / Activity" means it came from a synced activity, not a logged Interaction.
CustomField.label: Last Touch Type
